message.content: On February 24, 1815, Edmond Dantès, the beloved and promising young first mate of the ship *Pharaon*, returns triumphantly to Marseilles after successfully delivering a packet to Marshal Bertrand on Elba—and announcing his imminent promotion to captain and marriage to Mercédès—only to be met by the covert jealousy of his rival Fernand, the resentful supercargo Danglars, and the envious neighbor Caderousse, who, spurred by drink and ambition, begin to conspire against him, setting in motion the tragic events that will shatter his life.
